definitions.short: Abinadab , the name of four Israelites
definitions.full: H41. Abinadab אֲבִינָדָב proper name, masculine ( my father is noble ) 1 a man of Gibeah in whose house the ark tarried 1Sam 7:1 ; 2Sam 6:3 (twice in verse); 6:4 ; 1Chr 13:7 . 2 a son of Jesse 1Sam 16:8 ; 17:13 ; 1Kin 4:11 (? perhaps otherwise unknown; Klo proposes בְּ אֲבִינֵר ). 3 a son of Saul 1Sam 31:2 ; 1Chr 8:33 ; 9:39 ; 10:2 .
definitions.rootNote: from 1 and 5068 ; father of generosity (i.e. liberal);
